## 1. Overview & Identity

Sachit is a Software Developer and Prompt Engineer specializing in full-stack web development, AI automation workflows, custom Android operating system platforms (AOSP), and developer utilities.

- **Primary Role**: Software Developer & Prompt Engineer
- **Core Focus**: React, TypeScript, Vite, Next.js, Python, Anthropic Claude API, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Supabase, PostgreSQL
- **Design Language**: Tactile Kraft Paper aesthetic with physics-based 3D paper interactions (Three.js/WebGL)

## 3. Engineering Projects

### SKY ROMs
- **Category**: Android & Web Platform
- **Year**: 2025
- **Live Demo**: https://sky-roms.vercel.app/
- **Tech Stack**: React, TypeScript, Vite, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Capacitor, Android Studio, Tailwind CSS
- **Full Overview**: Full-stack platform for discovering, comparing, and managing Android custom ROMs and kernels. Built with a secure Supabase/PostgreSQL backend for user auth, role-based authorization, and real-time cloud data sync. Deployed natively to mobile via Capacitor.

### MoneyPal
- **Category**: Native Android & Wear OS Application
- **Year**: 2025
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/sachit1751-art/MoneyPal
- **Tech Stack**: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android SDK, Room Database, Wear OS, Git
- **Full Overview**: Native Android budget tracking application with calculator-style expense logging, automated recurring budget periods, Wear OS companion app for wrist-based entry, interactive home screen widgets, and offline-first Room database persistence.

### Audify
- **Category**: Web Audio & Streaming
- **Year**: 2025
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/sachit1751-art/Audify
- **Tech Stack**: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Web Audio API, Vite, Git
- **Full Overview**: Web audio streaming player featuring custom audio playback hooks, volume and frequency scrubbing via Web Audio API, real-time track search, responsive touch controls, and local preference storage.

### AI-Powered Model Context Protocol (MCP) Tool
- **Category**: AI Tooling & Automation
- **Year**: 2025
- **Tech Stack**: Python, Anthropic Claude API, Model Context Protocol (MCP), JSON-RPC, Context Injection
- **Full Overview**: Developer utility configuring Model Context Protocol server endpoints and clean JSON-RPC messaging handlers, enabling large language models to query local file systems, system datasets, and developer tools in real time.

### Tic-Tac-Toe Mini Game
- **Category**: Standalone Web Game
- **Year**: 2025
- **Tech Stack**: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript ES6+, Minimax Algorithm, Game State Logic
- **Full Overview**: Standalone browser game featuring Minimax AI move evaluation recursion for Easy and Hard opponent difficulty levels, delayed AI response feedback, turn locking, and responsive board UI.

## 4. Technical Skills Taxonomy

### Frontend Development
- **Languages & Frameworks**: React 18, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Vite
- **UI Architecture**: Micro-interactions, Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 / ARIA 1.2), Responsive Design, Custom Component Libraries
- **Interactive & 3D**: Three.js, WebGL, GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform), Canvas API

### Backend & Database Systems
- **Server Runtimes**: Node.js, Express, Python
- **Database & Storage**: PostgreSQL, Supabase, Room Database, REST APIs, JSON Fallback Persistence

### AI Engineering & Automation
- **LLM APIs**: Anthropic Claude API, OpenAI API
- **AI Tooling**: Model Context Protocol (MCP), Prompt Engineering, Prompt Caching, Context Injection Pipelines, Generative Workflows

### Mobile & System Development
- **Android Stack**: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android SDK, AOSP, Custom ROMs, Wear OS, Capacitor

---

## 5. Engineering Philosophy

1. **Learn by Building**: True understanding comes from shipping functional, end-to-end applications rather than passive observation.
2. **Keep It Simple**: Write clean, self-documenting code with zero unnecessary dependencies.
3. **Design First**: Technical excellence must be paired with intuitive, accessible, and delighting user interfaces.
